channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter Inc. - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: Brad Arnold, Lead Singer and Founding Member of 3 Doors Down, Dies at 47
item.description: The musician, who also served as the rock band's original drummer, revealed in August that he was diagnosed with stage 4 kidney cancer.

item.title: All of ‘The Beauty’ Cast & Characters: Ashton Kutcher, Evan Peters, Bella Hadid and More in Ryan Murphy’s Body Horror Series
item.description: The FX show, adapted by Murphy and longtime collaborator Matt Hodgson from the comic book, explores the extremes people will go to achieve perfection — with a star-studded cast.

item.title: Will Lewis Out as Washington Post CEO After Layoffs, Jeff D’Onofrio Succeeds
item.description: D’Onofrio will take over for Lewis just days after the company's mass layoffs, which resulted in one-third of its staff being let go and the sports department being eliminated in full.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie Acknowledges “Message” From Suspected Kidnappers of Mother Nancy Guthrie in New Video, Says “We Will Pay” to Bring Her Home
item.description: "We beg you now to return our mother to us so that we can celebrate with her," the 'Today' host said in a new video message on Instagram Saturday.

item.title: Sam Raimi Says Rachel McAdams Was “Underutilized” in ‘Doctor Strange’ Sequel
item.description: The director admitted he "promised" himself he would work with 'The Notebook' actress again following their time collaborating on 2022's 'Multiverse of Madness.'

item.title: Amazon MGM Goes on Offense as ‘Melania’ Risks Getting Sacked at Super Bowl Box Office
item.description: The first lady's documentary is falling off steeply in its second weekend, prompting Amazon MGM to go on the offensive and stress that the film is in it for the long game, whether theatrically or streaming.

item.title: Christopher Nolan Kicks Off DGA Awards With His First Presidential Speech, Acknowledging “Our Members Are Having Very Hard Times”
item.description: 'The Odyssey' filmmaker, who was elected president of the Directors Guild of America last year, spoke at Saturday's awards.

item.title: Trump Says Nexstar-Tegna Merger Will “Knock Out the Fake News,” FCC Chair Says “Let’s Get It Done”
item.description: "Those that are opposed don’t fully understand how good the concept of this Deal is for them, but they will in the future," the president wrote on Truth Social Saturday.

item.title: DGA Awards: Paul Thomas Anderson Takes Top Honor for ‘One Battle After Another’
item.description: Kumail Nanjiani hosted the ceremony honoring the best film and TV directors of the past year, with 'The Studio,' 'The Pitt,' 'Dying for Sex' and 'SNL50' also taking home honors.
